The '''Supercopa de Chile''' (''Supercup of Chile'') is an annual one-match [[football (soccer)|football]] official competition in Chile organised by the [[Asociación Nacional de Fútbol Profesional]] (ANFP).

This competition serves as the season opener and is played between the [[Chilean Primera División|Campeonato Nacional]] Champions and the winners of the [[Copa Chile]] of the previous season.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.anfp.cl/noticia/18252/la-supercopa-aguarda-al-campeon-de-los-campeones|title=LA SUPERCOPA AGUARDA AL CAMPEÓN DE LOS CAMPEONES|website=anfp.cl|access-date=20 April 2018}}</ref> On 14 October 2025, it was announced that the Supercopa would expand to four teams, the winners and runners-up of the Copa Chile and Campeonato Nacional.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Comunicado de Prensa – ANFP |url=https://www.anfp.cl/comunicado-de-prensa-9/ |access-date=2025-12-21 |language=es-CL}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Zavala |first=Jaime |date=2025-12-11 |title=Supercopa 2026: así quedaron las llaves de semifinales tras título de Huachipato en Copa Chile |url=https://www.biobiochile.cl/noticias/deportes/futbol/futbol-nacional/2025/12/11/supercopa-2026-asi-quedaron-las-llaves-de-semifinales-tras-titulo-de-huachipato-en-copa-chile.shtml |access-date=2025-12-21 |website=BioBioChile - La Red de Prensa Más Grande de Chile |language=es}}</ref>

==History==
On 14 May 2013, [[Sergio Jadue]], president of the [[Asociación Nacional de Fútbol Profesional|National Association of Professional Football of Chile]] (ANFP) decided to approve the creation of a supercup competition to be played by the champions of both the [[Chilean Primera División|Campeonato Nacional]] and the  [[Copa Chile]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=ANFP propone una Supercopa entre ganadores de Copa Chile y Campeonato |url=https://cooperativa.cl/noticias/deportes/futbol/campeonato-2013/anfp-propone-una-supercopa-entre-ganadores-de-copa-chile-y-campeonato/2013-05-14/130554.html |access-date=2025-12-21 |website=Cooperativa.cl |language=Spanish}}</ref> The first Supercopa was held that same year when [[Unión Española]] faced [[Club Universidad de Chile|Universidad de Chile]] at [[Estadio Regional de Antofagasta|Estadio Regional]] in Antofagasta.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |date=2013-07-11 |title=Unión le gana la Supercopa a la U y sella el adiós de Franco |url=https://www.emol.com/noticias/deportes/2013/07/10/608479/union-le-gana-la-supercopa-a-la-u-y-sentencia-aun-mas-el-triste-adios-de-franco.html |access-date=2025-12-21 |website=Emol |language=Spanish}}</ref>

The stadium that hosted the match and the date are defined when the two teams are qualified, for reason of distance between the two clubs. In 2013, the trophy was played in [[Antofagasta]],<ref name=":0" /> and in 2014 was played in [[Santiago de Chile|Santiago]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=ANFP designó a árbitro para la Supercopa entre O'Higgins e Iquique - el Gráfico Chile |url=http://www.elgraficochile.cl/anfp-designo-a-arbitro-para-la-supercopa-entre-o-higgins-e-iquique/prontus_elgrafico/2014-04-30/103024.html |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20141214224826/http://www.elgraficochile.cl/anfp-designo-a-arbitro-para-la-supercopa-entre-o-higgins-e-iquique/prontus_elgrafico/2014-04-30/103024.html |archive-date=2014-12-14 |access-date=2014-09-29}}</ref>
